SELECT
    '{{ $json.designation }}' AS designation,
    '{{ $json.montant_ht }}'     AS montant,
    '{{ $json.numero_facture }}'          AS num_facture,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(p.XNFACT_0) > 0 THEN 'EXISTE' ELSE 'INEXISTANT' END AS status,
    COUNT(p.XNFACT_0)                     AS nb_lignes
FROM (SELECT 1 AS dummy) d
LEFT JOIN BASE1.PRECEIPT p
       ON p.XNFACT_0 = '{{ $json.numero_facture }}'

SELECT
    O.POHNUM_0,
    O.BPSNUM_0,
    O.ORDDAT_0,
    O.XMARQ_0,
    1 AS QTYPUU_0,
    O.QTYPUU_0 as quantite_total,
    O.RCPQTYPUU_0 as quantite_receptionne,
    A.ITMREF_0,
    A.ITMDES1_0,
  '{{ $json.num_facture }}' as numero_facture
FROM BASE1.PORDERQ O
INNER JOIN BASE1.ITMMASTER A ON O.ITMREF_0 = A.ITMREF_0
WHERE O.POHNUM_0 = 'BC167990'
  AND O.ITMREF_0 = 'A13302'
GROUP BY
    O.POHNUM_0,
    O.BPSNUM_0,
    O.ORDDAT_0,
    O.XMARQ_0,
    A.ITMREF_0,
    A.ITMDES1_0,
